revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, looking into a public lobby with reception furniture, columns, and a durable tiled floor made of large neutral tiles. Warm practical interior lighting, natural perspective, realistic scale, slightly distant oblique view, medium-wide framing, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Visible subject: an older adult man with a stocky build wearing a charcoal cardigan, muted orange workwear accents, and practical shoes; he is sitting on one bent leg with the other leg extended, hips low but torso clearly non-horizontal. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising. Include a safety rail and a distant worker-shaped silhouette that is not the subject. No text, captions, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
